id: DEC-0001
title: Use public endpoints with IP allow lists
date: 2026-01-10
decision-makers: [platform-team]
superseded-by: DEC-0002
---

## Context

The ledger needed network access from two regions.

## Options

- Public endpoints with IP allow lists
- Private endpoints

## Decision

We use public endpoints because private endpoints were not available yet.

## Consequences

Setup is simple. Allow lists need upkeep.
